title: A 7/8 meter at a fractional tempo
teaches: Meter divides beats inside a bar; the per-bar tick count is constant. A fractional bpm moves only the seconds-to-ticks seam, and beats, bars, seconds and emitted lanes can be mixed in one score.
observe: One bar is seven beats, and phase runs 0..1 across that bar.
The 3 s key is off the beat grid but still lands exactly on its authored value.
At 7 s the 2-bar loop has wrapped back to bar 0.
